history: always-repro'd across v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607 (all 20 releases probed linearly, no invalid probes); v1.6.2104 shipped 2021-04-20, two days before the report, and reproduces
summary: Still reproduces on main and in all 20 bisectable releases measured from v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607: exit 0, no diagnostic, undef in the rawBufferLoad index operand. DXC already has the check -- -Wall / -Wuninitialized reports it -- but it is off by default, and it does not fire on the tested partially-initialized int2 index; FXC (vs_5_0) rejects the same source with error X4000.
title: Passing uninitialized var as index to structure buffer causes undef being passed in dxil
